name: Mill house with waterwheel
description: Stone water mill and miller's house, 14 x 9.6 m under a slate roof, with a lean-to wheelhouse annex on the east gable sheltering an oak breast-shot waterwheel (4.2 m, sixteen spokes, buckets) in its stone race. Mill room with the millstones, store; two bedrooms over; two stairs; ivy.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
